assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under CARC code CO-97.
The service at issue is CPT 93271.
CPT 93271 corresponds to a cardiac event monitoring study.
There is a clinical indication note associated with the case.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The presentation raises concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The applicable diagnosis codes are Z86.73, G45.9, and I48.0.
The cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of the transient cerebral ischemic events.
The cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to guide anticoagulation management.
